info.title: MAIS Wellbest API Documentation
info.description: Standard OpenAPI documentation for the MAIS Wellbest application.

post.description: Login with email and password to receive an API token.
Revokes the current user's API token.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of departments.

post.description: Stores a new department and returns the created department data.

put.description: Updates an existing department and returns the updated department data.

delete.description: Deletes a department record and returns no content.
